name: sikto
description: Sikto monorepo: Next.js web + FastAPI api

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,render,tts -c cyan,blue,magenta,green "cd apps/web && pnpm dev" "cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd apps/render && pnpm dev" "cd apps/tts && uv run uvicorn tts.main:app --app-dir src --port 8002"
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -k -n api,render,tts -c blue,magenta,green "cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd apps/render && pnpm dev" "cd apps/tts && uv run uvicorn tts.main:app --app-dir src --port 8002"
scripts.dev:api-only: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000
